top_signals.title: Sumer Group’s HW Fisher sanctioned over GFG Alliance audit lapses
top_signals.summary: The watchdog has fined a Sumer Group entity and one of its partners £200,000 for serious professional failures during an audit of Liberty Commodities, a group within metals tycoon Sanjeev Gupta’s GFG Alliance. The Financial Reporting Council (FRC) said Sumer Group’s HW Fisher and lead auditor Simon Mott-Cowan showed a pervasive lack of “professional scepticism” [...]
